Refs #ISSUE_NUMBER

## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and relevant OpenSpec change.

## Validation

List local commands and evidence, including real proof controls when applicable.
State untested platforms and limitations. Cache hits never replace assertions.

## Review

- [ ] Every commit is conventional, GPG-signed and has my matching DCO sign-off.
- [ ] PR and every commit reference a real issue using `Refs #N` on its own line.
- [ ] Specs/docs and compatibility evidence reflect the final change.
- [ ] No secrets, unapproved pins, compiler modifications or publishing changes.
- [ ] AI-assisted commits include `Assisted-by: AI` where applicable.
